Violation when means does not state feature, or ends introduces another required feature instead of explaining why means valuable.

Need classify each. Need be careful. We need use full backlog only if criterion requires set-level or contextual. It's individual, assess each story primarily own text. Need return one object per story id, exactly 53. Decision binary no uncertain. Evidence short text span. Rationale concise.

Let's understand criterion. A user story format: As a <role>, I want <means>, so that <ends/benefit/rationale>. Conceptually sound if means is feature and ends rationale for feature. Violations: means not state a feature (maybe non-functional? but still feature?), or ends introduces another required feature instead of explaining why. Need evaluate.

Let's inspect each.

We need output all 53.

Let's reason each:

PP-001: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description, so that I can start inviting estimators.
Means: create a new game by entering name/description. Feature. Ends: can start inviting estimators. That's rationale? yes explains why creating game valuable. No violation.

PP-002: As moderator, invite estimators by giving them URL, so that we can start the game.
Means feature invite estimators. Ends rationale: can start game. No violation.

PP-003: start a round by entering item in single multi-line text field, so that we can estimate it.
Means feature start round entering item. Ends: can estimate it. Rationale for starting round. No violation.

Means feature see all items. Ends rationale: answer questions. No violation.

Means feature select item. Ends: team sees item and can estimate. Rationale. No violation.
